entry.command: python3 -B -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; r=lambda p:Path(p).read_text().strip(); print(json.dumps({"boot_id":r("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id"),"uptime":r("/proc/uptime"),"kernel":r("/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease"),"sd_cid":r("/sys/class/block/mmcblk1/device/cid"),"cmdline":r("/proc/cmdline")}))'

systemctl show dfx-mgr.service kv260-repaired-zocl.service proc-fs-nfsd.mount nfs-server.service nfs-mountd.service -p Id -p UnitFileState -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p MainPID -p ConditionResult -p ConditionTimestampMonotonic -p DropInPaths -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic -p Requires -p After

python3 -B -c 'import hashlib,json; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("/etc/systemd/system/proc-fs-nfsd.mount.d/20-kv260-nfs-capability.conf"); d=p.read_bytes(); print(json.dumps({"path":str(p),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest(),"content":d.decode()}))'
